actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. This is a conservative FAITHFUL higher-resolution repaint of the exact old bitmap, not a redesign. Match the entire original image with deliberate source softness, low contrast and ALL original fine stroke phase. Do not add detail where the source is blurry.

Keep the original eye-area tan-gray painted wash smooth. NO branching blood vessels, vein lines, new thin scratches or sclera texture; only the exact existing dim source marks. Keep the existing iris, pupil and original reflections unchanged in size and UV position.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this ENTIRE exact original Silent Storm painted character UV color atlas 2170, Heads\14.AxelBieber\0.tga, into a faithful four-times finer version. Image1 is the full ACTUAL selected native stored RGB, the edit target. Keep the exact complete square canvas and normalized coordinates of EVERY region, including ALL original dark/black unused UV fields and the untouched clipped features at the borders. Output only one flat full texture bitmap.

Preserve the character's original identity, facial proportions, expression, age, skin pigment, hair color/style and softly painted old-game material. The original face is STORED UPSIDE DOWN. KEEP this orientation. Never flip, rotate, crop, rearrange, zoom, center a portrait, repack quadrants, change island sizes, or add margins. Keep all original support color fields and inter-island separation.

Treat the upper-left small eyelash and dental UV region as a painted schematic EXACTLY copied from the reference: preserve EVERY original visible vertical/diagonal thin stroke and dark gap, exact stroke count, length, placement and terminal fades. Preserve EACH existing tooth and tooth separation, mouth stripe width/height/row count and native shape at the original UV positions; do not make a realistic extra set of teeth, regular white dental band, extra glints, changed gum shape or extra eyelashes. Preserve the existing eye region, single pupil, source reflections and colored background exactly at its original UV location. Keep the original eye color and facial marks.

Improve only fine resolution of existing softly painted transitions and edges. Retain the original brush softness and matte character surface, broad shading, faint local marks, subtle forehead creases, ears and boundaries. No photorealistic skin pores, wrinkles, hair fibers, new scars, freckles, added dental structure, beard reinterpretation, cosmetics, beautification, sharp contrast, new shine, or extra anatomy. Preserve source shape/count/phase/material/pattern scale and color hierarchy rather than inventing small objects. Whole selected source alpha and brightness are restored programmatically; generate the complete opaque stored RGB canvas without changing layout or painting into original black unused regions.
